title: Bench Note on Handling a Customer-Supplied Centre Stone When a Change Is Agreed
content:
# Bench Note on Handling a Customer-Supplied Centre Stone When a Change Is Agreed

On a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions, what handling the centre stone is charged at when a change to the specification is agreed turns on where the centre stone came from and on whether a stone setting stage stands recorded on the commission.

## The rates

- Where the centre stone is one the customer supplied and a stone setting stage stands recorded on the commission, handling the centre stone is charged at the programme's stone sourcing fee rate on what the commission is worth.
- Where the centre stone is one the customer supplied and no stone setting stage stands recorded on the commission, it is charged at 2 per cent on what the commission is worth.
- Otherwise nothing is charged for handling the centre stone.

The centre stone's source stands on the commission record; a stone setting stage stands recorded where an entry for that stage of production has been booked to the commission.

## The programme's stone sourcing fee rate

| Programme | Stone sourcing fee rate |
|---|---|
| Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting | 0 per cent |
| Design Studio Custom Setting | 6 per cent |
| Belrose Bespoke Design | 8 per cent |
| Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission | 8 per cent |
| Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission | 6 per cent |
| Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission | 12 per cent |

## Both sides of the condition (hypothetical)

Take a commission whose centre stone the customer supplied and which is worth USD 20000.00.

| Where | Rate | Charge for handling the centre stone |
|---|---|---|
| Under Belrose Bespoke Design with a stone setting stage recorded | 8 per cent | USD 1600.00 |
| Under Belrose Bespoke Design with no stone setting stage recorded | 2 per cent | USD 400.00 |
| Under the Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting with a stone setting stage recorded | 0 per cent | USD 0.00 |
| Where the centre stone came from the chain's own inventory | — | Nothing is charged for handling the centre stone |
